title: Provolola Elote Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional street food, this taco combines spicy elote with the creamy goodness of provola cheese.
instructions: Grill corn until slightly charred and tender.
Warm tortillas by wrapping in foil and heating in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
Combine sliced provola and grilled corn in a bowl.
Warm naan on the grill or in the oven.
Assemble tacos by placing provola mixture onto naan.
Optional: top with cilantro or a dollop of raita for extra flavor.
Serve with a side of raita or a simple green salad for a well-rounded meal.
